articles.title: Japan's inflation picks up, keeping BOJ on path for rate hikes

articles.title: US Stock Market: US Treasury's growing reliance on short-term bills sparks debate over borrowing risks
articles.description: The US Treasury is increasing short-term bill issuance to meet rising funding needs. This strategy aims to rebuild government cash balances and finance seasonal spending requirements. Analysts express concerns about long-term risks from heavy reliance on short-duration debt. Money market funds are absorbing much of this issuance, though demand may face seasonal pressures. This approach could limit flexibility during future financial emergencies.

articles.title: Smaller stocks gain ground as largecaps lose market share
articles.description: Large-cap stocks have seen their market share decline over six years. Mid, small, and micro-cap stocks have gained significant ground during this period. The Nifty's share of total market capitalization fell to a multi-year low. Meanwhile, the Nifty Smallcap 250 reached a multi-year high. This trend highlights the increasing weight of smaller companies in the market.

articles.title: HSBC to sell Singapore insurance unit to Allianz in $2.1 billion deal
articles.description: HSBC will sell its Singapore life and health insurance business to Allianz. This deal is valued at S$2.7 billion and is expected to close in early 2027. The sale will help HSBC simplify its operations and focus on core markets. Allianz gains a significant expansion opportunity in Singapore's regulated market. HSBC will continue distributing insurance products through a 15-year bancassurance agreement.
